changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment:
ADR-0017: the eBay Browse API allows 5000 calls per day for the whole application, so the budget is rationed across users. This table holds the shared counter per quota day plus the moment eBay itself declared the day spent.
This is the only persistence the purchase-offers feature has. Prices are deliberately not stored (they go stale in minutes), but the exhaustion flag must survive a restart: otherwise an evening deploy clears the day's lockout and the application resumes calling an allowance eBay considers gone.
quota_day is a day in eBay's reset zone, not ours -- see QuotaDay.

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment:
Per-user share of the same day's budget. Its own table rather than columns on app_user: the user belongs to accountaccess and the budget to purchaseoffers, and a column there would write to the user row on every price lookup.
user_id is intentionally not a foreign key to app_user -- purchaseoffers does not map to another context's entity. Cleaning up rows of deleted users is an open point in ADR-0017, to be solved from this side.
